benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card is a credit card option from Kotak Mahindra Bank suited for travel & miles users with 4 domestic lounge visits/yr.
highlights: 5 Air Miles per Rs. 100 spent on booking flight, flight add-ons, hotel and hotel add-ons via Kotak Unbox, along with auto dealer merchants (5 Air Miles include 3 accelerated and 2 base Air Miles)
2 Air Miles per Rs. 100 spent on other categories
15,000 Air Miles per month for accelerated Air Miles (3 Air Miles) on eligible Kotak Unbox spends
benefits_features_and_faqs.welcome_benefit: Welcome Bonus: 3,000 Air Miles on joining fee payment
milestone_benefits: 1 Air Mile = Rs. 0.5 for instant vouchers on Kotak Unbox
Fee Waiver: Annual fee waived off on Rs. 4 lakh annual spends
Fuel Benefit: 1% fuel surcharge waiver, up to Rs. 4,500 per year, on fuel spends of Rs. 400 to Rs. 7,500
get_this_card_if: You are a frequent traveller and are looking for a credit card that offers good travel savings
You can optimise the card’s usage and savings by making your travel bookings on Kotak Unbox platform
You often use partner airlines and hotels for your travel and can save well by Air Miles transfer to the respective partner miles

faqs.q: How is Kotak Air+ Prime different from Kotak Air+ Credit Card? Which is better?
faqs.a: Both Kotak Air+ and Kotak Air+ Prime credit cards come at an annual fee of Rs. 3,000 and offer similar benefits with minor differences. Kotak Air+ offers 2,500 Air Miles as joining and renewal bonus, while Kotak Air+ Prime offers 3,000 Air Miles instead. Kotak Air+ offers accelerated rewards only on flight/hotel bookings on Kotak Unbox, Kotak Air+ Prime also offers higher rewards on flight/hotel add-ons on Unbox, along with auto dealer merchants. Moreover, the Prime card variant also comes with an annual fee waiver option. So, the Prime variant is a better card option.

faqs.q: How to waive the fee of Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can waive the annual fee of Kotak Air+ Prime credit card by spending Rs. 4 lakh or more in a year.

faqs.q: How many Air Miles can I earn on international spends using Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card?
faqs.a: International transactions are excluded from the reward program of Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card, so you do not earn any Air Miles on these spends.

faqs.q: What are the partner airlines and hotels for Air Miles to partner miles transfer option for Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can convert your accrued Air Miles using Kotak Air+ Prime credit card into partner loyalty points for airlines and hotels like Marriott, Accor, Air India, Air Canada, Air France, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airlines and United Airlines.

faqs.q: How can I access Kotak Unbox platform as Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card user?
faqs.a: You can access Kotak Unbox on Kotak Mahindra Bank mobile app. Login to the app and either click on Wallet or Credit Cards option and select Kotak Air+ Prime Credit Card. Then scroll to the Air Miles section to check your accrued Air Miles balance and click on Redeem option to access Kotak Unbox.
